title: Bosch Urea Diesel Filter Guide
excerpt: Bosch urea diesel filter part 1 457 436 033, SCR system basics, features, PDF downloads, and Class 4 through Class 8 application coverage.
description: Medium and heavy duty trucks manufactured starting on January 1, 2010 are required to meet EPA emission standards. Many truck manufacturers use selective catalytic reduction technology, where Bosch dosing systems inject urea into the exhaust so it can interact with the SCR catalyst and reduce NOx emissions. The Bosch urea diesel filter protects the supply module by filtering urea before it reaches the dosing module.
imageAlt: Bosch urea diesel filter part 1 457 436 033 for SCR diesel truck dosing systems

resourceSections.title: Bosch Urea Diesel Filter Part 1 457 436 033
resourceSections.text: The Bosch Urea Filter for diesel applications is designed for and supplied to original equipment manufacturers. Bosch states that this single SKU covers up to 69 percent of Class 4 through Class 8 trucks in operation, making it a practical stock item for diesel repair shops, fleets, and parts counters.

image.alt: Features of Bosch urea diesel filter with O rings equalizing element and extraction tool

items: High capacity media provides protection to original equipment manufacturer change intervals.
Included O rings provide a tight seal which helps prevent leaks.
The Bosch exclusive equalizing element buffers pressure within the pump by expanding and contracting to help prevent cracking on internal components.
The supplied extraction tool makes filter removal easier.

resourceSections.title: Replace During Scheduled Service
resourceSections.text: As part of the SCR dosing system, the supply module contains a main filter that filters urea being pumped into the dosing module. That filter should be replaced according to the manufacturer's scheduled maintenance requirements. Keeping the filter current helps protect the dosing module and supports correct SCR system operation.
items: Filters urea before it reaches the dosing module.
Helps protect the supply module and dosing components.
Useful for medium duty and heavy duty truck service planning.

title: Ford Powerstroke Installation Guide
excerpt: Installation notes for Ford Powerstroke injectors, including 6.0L HEUI and 6.7L common rail applications.
description: Proper injector installation on Ford Powerstroke engines prevents comebacks. This guide covers torque specs, copper washer handling, oil supply concerns on 6.0L HEUI systems, and post-install checks for 6.7L common rail trucks.

title: Dodge Cummins Installation Guide
excerpt: Installation guidance for Dodge and Ram Cummins common rail injectors and related service points.
description: Cummins common rail injectors on Dodge and Ram trucks require clean handling and correct torque. This guide outlines tube nut care, injector hold-down torque, leak-off routing, and basic post-install verification for 5.9L and 6.7L platforms.

title: Duramax Diesel Injector Guide
excerpt: How to identify worn Duramax injectors, when to test, and what replacement options shops have.
description: Hard starts, rough idle, smoke, and codes often trace back to injector wear on Duramax engines. This guide explains common failure signs by generation, when bench testing makes sense, and how to match the right Bosch injector to the application.
